## Getting started


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf, sfdep, spdep, tmap, tidyverse, knitr)
```
:::


## Importing data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "Hunan")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

  using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
```

:::

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan <- left_join(hunan, hunan2012) %>%
  select(1:4, 7, 15,33)
```
:::


## Deriving Queen's contiguity weights: sfdep method


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wm_q <- hunan %>%
  mutate(nb = st_contiguity(geometry),
         wt = st_weights(nb, style = "W"),
         .before = 1)

summary(wm_q$nb)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

## Computing Global Moran's I


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
moranI <- global_moran(wm_q$GDPPC, wm_q$nb, wm_q$wt)
glimpse(moranI)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
List of 2
 $ I: num 0.301
 $ K: num 7.64
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
global_moran_test(wm_q$GDPPC, wm_q$nb, wm_q$wt)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


## Performing Global Moran's I permutation test


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1234)
global_moran_perm(wm_q$GDPPC, wm_q$nb, wm_q$wt, nsim = 99)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

	Monte-Carlo simulation of Moran I

data:  x 
weights: listw  
number of simulations + 1: 100 

statistic = 0.30075, observed rank = 100, p-value < 2.2e-16
alternative hypothesis: two.sided
```


:::
:::


## Computing local Moran's I


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lisa <- wm_q %>%
  mutate(local_moran = local_moran(GDPPC, nb, wt, nsim = 99),
         .before = 1) %>%
  unnest(local_moran)
```
:::


## Visualising local Moran's I


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(lisa) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "ii",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "fixed",
                breaks = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
                values = "brewer.rd_bu"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Local Moran's I")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title("local Moran's I of GDPPC") +
  tm_layout(legend.text.size = 1.2)
```
